description: Monthly listing inventory from Realtor.com (median asking price, active, new and pending listings, median days on market, share with price cuts, pending ratio, each with the publisher's month-over-month and year-over-year change), FHFA House Price Index appreciation, Census building permits (new housing units authorized, month and year to date, for counties and cities), BLS county unemployment and Washington OFM population (counties and whole cities) for a Washington ZIP, county, city or metro. Every block names its publisher, period, file hash and required attribution. A median listing price is an asking price, not a sale price. Quote numbers verbatim with their period and reproduce each required attribution. Unknown areas are free. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
